findings.title: Adopted-branch "pr" recommendation label has no test
findings.detail: questionBranchFinish's adopted-branch early return now does `pr.Label += suffixRecommended` (line 409), a new behaviour — before this diff the adopted branch never marked any option "(Recommended)". TestQuestionBranchFinishRecommendsAChoosableOption (internal/decide/finish_test.go) only covers the non-adopted merge-blocked/merge-allowed cases; the existing adopted-branch assertion in TestBranchFinishOptions (finish_test.go:227-232) checks only option order/choice, never the label text. No test would catch a regression that dropped the suffix or duplicated it in the adopted path.

findings.title: alignmentVerdictLine's "unknown verdict" bucket is untested
findings.detail: The refactor into alignmentVerdictLine adds a new branch (lines 624-633) that buckets and sorts any verdict word outside alignmentVerdictOrder rather than silently dropping it — a genuinely new code path per the doc comment ("nothing validates the auditor's word"). No test in internal/cli/cmd_status_test.go supplies an alignment.json verdict outside {covered, narrowed, dropped, widened, contradicted}, so this branch (and its sort.Strings ordering) has zero coverage.

findings.title: PlanGate.Reason wiring only exercised indirectly, not through gatherGateFacts
findings.detail: Both SpecGate and PlanGate literals in gatherGateFacts gain `Reason: s.Reason` (lines 135-137 and 143-145). The spec-gate branch is covered end-to-end by TestAnswerRetryOnAnErroredGateWritesNothingAndClearsIt (internal/cli/cmd_answer_retry_test.go), which plants a real error receipt and drives it through gate.Compute → gatherGateFacts → decide → question. The plan-gate branch's Reason threading is only checked via decide_test.go's TestTheGateReviewAskCarriesTheReceiptsReason/plan subtest, which constructs `decide.GateStatus{Verdict: "error", Reason: "x"}` directly and never calls gatherGateFacts or gate.Compute — so a bug specifically in facts.go's plan-gate literal (e.g. a typo omitting `Reason: s.Reason`) would not be caught by any test.
